info.title: InnoDD API
info.description:
Complete InnoDD drug-discovery platform surface, generated from source (not the Postman collection).

**Two surfaces:**
- `/api/v1/*` — legacy internal pipeline modules (TxKG, Literature Mining, Drug Curation, Screening, Novelty Search) plus Auth/Users/Items scaffolding and job Orchestration. No X-Drp-Token needed.
- `/v1/*` — the DRP frontend-facing contract (async job pattern: POST creates a job -> 202 {jobId}, then poll status/result). Needs `X-Drp-Token` (or `Authorization: Bearer`) from `/v1/auth/login`.

**Known gaps / stubs (do not rely on for testing):**
- `POST /api/v1/auth/login` and `/api/v1/auth/token` are unimplemented stubs (`pass`) in the legacy scaffold.
- `/api/v1/users/*` imports a `UserRead` model that does not exist in `app/schemas/user.py` — this router likely fails to import and is NOT actually mounted.
- `/api/v1/agentic/*` never mounts — `agent_routes.py` does not exist as a file; `_include()` swallows the ImportError.
- Several module routers are double-mounted: Literature Mining, Drug Curation, Screening, and Novelty Search each exist BOTH under their versioned prefix (e.g. `/api/v1/literature-mining/...`) AND again with no prefix as a legacy alias (e.g. `/api/v1/search-keywords/`) — both paths are live simultaneously and hit the same handler.

drpToken.name: X-Drp-Token
drpToken.description: Access token returned by POST /v1/auth/login or /v1/auth/refresh. The server also accepts a standard Authorization: Bearer header as a fallback.

LitMineXRequest.description: At least one of query/target/disease is required.
